Congratulations to your sister on her big day—may it be as radiant as the mehendi itself! 💛✨

For example, an automated system might not differentiate between a minor infraction and a serious violation, which could lead to unjust outcomes. In summary, the act of assigning a binary value (0 or 1) itself isn't inherently right or wrong. It depends on how it is implemented, the fairness of the system, and whether it accounts for fairness, transparency, and human judgment. If the system is fair and transparent, it can be considered right; if it is arbitrary, biased, or lacks flexibility, it could be seen as wrong.
